method: Individual transparent recolor edits of existing transmitter.png and receiver.png; methane also uses user tank color reference

images.color: deep clear petrol RED, body enamel #ac302d, bright red waves; no orange or blue
images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the first image, an existing transparent game inventory icon. Produce ONE square transparent icon variant for the Petrol wireless Transmitter. Recolor the device's light painted metal panels, radio wave glyphs and directional arrow to deep clear petrol RED, body enamel #ac302d, bright red waves; no orange or blue. Preserve exactly the existing device geometry, silhouette, camera perspective, metal wear, radio wave shapes and arrow direction. Leave dark structural metal mostly neutral dark gray; color the main light body panels so resource color is visible at 64px. Preserve composition with every antenna tip and full device safely inside canvas, about 5% clear margin. No labels, letters, logos, extra devices, background, ground or shadow. This is an icon, no environment. TRUE transparent alpha background. For Methane only, second image is the user's tank COLOR reference, not a shape to copy.
